categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in the medical device industry, with six main business segments: patient monitoring, electrocardiogram (ECG) diagnosis, maternal and child health, ultrasound imaging, in vitro diagnostics (IVD), and smart health. These segments cover a wide range of medical electronic equipment and diagnostic products, including monitoring systems, ultrasound devices, blood gas analyzers, and health information platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as microfluidics, biosensors, electrochemical and optical detection, artificial intelligence, and big data analytics. It employs automated and intelligent manufacturing processes, including automated production lines and quality control systems, to ensure high product quality and efficiency. The R&D focuses on physiological signal detection, medical transducers, control platforms, blood gas and electrolyte analysis, magnetic fluorescence immunoassay, and ultrasound imaging technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include hospitals, clinics, and healthcare institutions globally, with over 50,000 medical institutions served in China alone. The company targets clinical departments such as intensive care units, emergency rooms, obstetrics, cardiology, and laboratory diagnostics. Its products are used in acute and critical care, maternal-fetal monitoring, cardiovascular diagnostics, and point-of-care testing, serving both developed and emerging markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global presence with products sold in over 170 countries and regions. It has established subsidiaries and R&D centers in China, the United States, Europe, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Thailand, Peru, and other locations. The company emphasizes localizing overseas operations, with nearly 90% of overseas employees being local hires, and has recently expanded its footprint with new subsidiaries in Indonesia and France.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the medical device supply chain, focusing on research and development, manufacturing, and sales of medical diagnostic and monitoring equipment. It manages a global supply chain with centralized procurement from multiple suppliers, emphasizing supply stability, cost control, and quality assurance. The company also integrates after-sales service and software solutions to provide comprehensive clinical support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation driven by clinical needs, expanding intelligent and digital medical devices, and deepening global localization. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on AI integration, smart diagnostics, and comprehensive healthcare solutions. It pursues collaborations with international organizations like the Gates Foundation to develop affordable medical devices for low- and middle-income countries. The company also emphasizes talent development, organizational efficiency, and compliance to support sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of medical devices and related consumables, including blood gas test cartridges and reagents. The company also earns income from after-sales services, software licensing, and integrated healthcare solutions. Sales are mainly conducted through a buyout distribution model with dealers, supplemented by direct sales. The company’s revenue is diversified across domestic and international markets, with a growing contribution from overseas sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic medical device manufacturer with strong competitiveness in patient monitoring, maternal and child health, and ECG diagnosis. It has broken the monopoly of imported brands in blood gas analysis in China and holds a leading market share in several segments. Its global presence and comprehensive product portfolio place it among the top-tier medical device suppliers in China, competing with both domestic and international players in various specialized medical fields.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately 1.83 billion RMB, a 5.35% decrease from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about 162 million RMB, down 26.75%. Despite a decline in domestic sales, international sales grew by 14.54%. The company maintains a strong cash flow position with operating cash flow increasing by nearly 146%. It continues to invest significantly in R&D, accounting for over 18% of revenue, and is expanding production capacity and global market reach.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes innovation, high-quality, and cost-effective medical devices tailored to clinical needs. Its products integrate advanced AI and digital technologies to enhance diagnostic accuracy and operational efficiency. It offers comprehensive solutions combining hardware, software, and services, enabling seamless clinical workflows and data interoperability. The company’s global localization strategy and strong after-sales service network further differentiate it by providing responsive and customized support worldwide.
